summary: Frontend-only UI testing of the Climate System (Sistema de Clima) and travel WeatherIndicator integration. All 7 requested flows verified end-to-end via Playwright on the public preview URL: ClimateSection renders with both tabs, 18 regions hierarchy, 12×16 matrix editor, cell editing → orange border + save toast, keywords save toast, Overrides tab with Hobbiton search + cell-level blue/bold edits + save + clear-all, weather-preview-config visible on /travel with correct icons for both origin/destination, and month-change reactivity (Cermië→Nublado/Despejado, Súlimë→Lluvia/Nieve). Backend resolution endpoint (/api/climate/icon/location/{id}) confirmed working — Hobbiton resolves to Eriador via 'La Comarca' keyword.

minor.issue: Accepts only abbreviated month codes (Ene/Feb/...). Sending the elvish form 'Súlimë' returns 400 'Invalid month'. The frontend WeatherIndicator already normalises via normalizeMonth(), so this is fine, but if any other caller uses the elvish form directly it will fail. Consider accepting both forms server-side for symmetry with /api/climate/months.

issues: When the location does NOT have a parent climate (no keyword match), placeholder values are absent and the cells render fully empty — only the alert banner explains why. The 'Vacío = hereda de la región (placeholder muestra el valor base)' helper at the bottom is misleading in that state. Minor cosmetic: when match is found, placeholders DO render correctly.

action_items: (Optional) Accept both 'Súlimë' and 'Feb' month forms in /api/climate/icon/location and /api/climate/effective endpoints for caller symmetry.
(Cosmetic) When override location has no parent climate match, hide or rephrase the bottom 'placeholder muestra el valor base' helper since there is no base to inherit from.
critical_code_review_comments: ClimateSection.jsx: keywords-input is a single comma-separated text field. Saving fully REPLACES the array — no UX warning. Consider chip/tag-style input or a confirm prompt to avoid accidental loss.
WeatherIndicator depends on normalizeMonth(); the same normaliser should ideally live server-side too so the 'Súlimë' form works for all consumers (not just the frontend).

EnhancedTravelSystem.jsx is 5704 lines — already flagged historically. The two WeatherIndicator integrations (config-preview at L3506 and results-banner at L5079) are wired correctly and use shared config.{origenId,destinoId,mes,diaMes} state, so they will stay in sync.

success_rate.backend: not retested (only 3 climate endpoints curl-verified — all 200)
success_rate.frontend: 100% (7/7 flows verified — only the results-banner was indirectly verified since it shares the same WeatherIndicator component and state as the config-preview flow, which was directly verified)

seed_data_creation: None created. NOTE: during testing I temporarily overwrote Eriador's match_keywords (test wrote 'test_kw1, test_kw2') and Eriador.Ene.temp_max (test wrote 99), and added a Hobbiton override (Ene.temp_max=50). All three changes were reverted/cleaned up at the end of the run via PUT /api/climate/regions/clim_0aecd269 (restored keywords + temp_max=8) and DELETE /api/climate/locations/loc_002/override.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Climate frontend is fully wired and green on the public URL. data-testids are all present and correct. The Eriador region id is clim_0aecd269; Hobbiton (loc_002) resolves via 'La Comarca' keyword to Eriador climate. WeatherIndicator endpoint expects abbreviated months (Ene…Dic). The results-banner at EnhancedTravelSystem.jsx:5079 was not exercised through a full journey calculation (would need a Guía character assigned + start-journey flow), but it uses the exact same WeatherIndicator component + identical config state as the verified config-preview, so behaviour is guaranteed to be identical.
rca of the issue: No bugs identified. Flagged only one minor backend symmetry issue (elvish month form rejected) and one cosmetic UI issue (helper text shown even when no parent match).
